  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω),
  LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (Φ : (ℕ → Ω) → Ω → ℝ),
      Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) →
        (∀ (s s' : ℕ → Ω) (b : Ω), (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Φ s b = Φ s' b) →
          (MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) ↑P ↔
              (∀ᵐ (ω : Ξ) ∂↑P, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun b => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b) ↑μ) ∧
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ∫ (b : Ω), ‖Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b‖ ∂↑μ) ↑P) ∧
            (MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω)) ↑P →
              ∫ (ω : Ξ), Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) (ξ k ω) ∂↑P = ∫ (ω : Ξ), ∫ (b : Ω), Φ (fun j => ξ j ω) b ∂↑μ ∂↑P)
